notes.title: 📢 Release Date Update
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p align="start"]I want to let you know about a change to the release schedule of [b]Courier Life Simulator[/b]. The game was originally set to release on [b]September 25[/b], but as a solo developer with a full-time job, I simply don’t have enough time to finish everything properly by then.[/p][p align="start"]The new release date will be [b]October 20th[/b]. This will still be an [b]Early Access launch[/b], but with the extra time I’ll be able to add more features that were originally planned for later in Early Access—so the game will arrive with more content from day one.[/p][p align="start"]I’m truly sorry for this delay, and I promise this won’t happen again. Thank you so much for your patience and support—it really keeps me motivated. 🙏[/p][p align="start"]As a bonus, I’ll be uploading a new version of the [b]demo next week[/b], so you can try out the improvements before launch.[/p][p align="start"]Thanks again for understanding, and I can’t wait for you to experience [b]Courier Life Simulator[/b] soon![/p]
